verdict.rationale: Square maintains a public 'connect-api-specification' GitHub repo (square-docs-19) which is the canonical OpenAPI spec for the Square API, and SDKs are auto-generated from it (square-gh-1), showing a machine-readable spec exists. However, probes for standard discoverable endpoints (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known/openapi.json) on the developer docs domain all returned 404 (square-probe-3), so there's no direct, prominently-documented download link on the docs site itself. missing for 10: a documented/discoverable openapi.json or equivalent endpoint on developer.squareup.com, and explicit docs page pointing users to the spec file for download.
